name: mixed_search
purpose: MC1 of the mixed-calibration 2x study: the formal D1 forward-baseline full search on calib.s0m_mix_2x@v2 alone, its unique Top-1 committed, re-identified and relayed (plans/mixed_application.json, logs/budget/approvals/mixed_calibration_grant.json)

2x._search_run_id: the SEARCH's identity (it enters config_hash): stable across every MC1 session, so a replacement session resumes the same search from the volume's journal
2x._search_config_hash: SearchConfig.config_hash on device cuda, computed at $0 by search_driver.py --check-only --device cuda (2026-10-26): the pod refuses any other search identity

search._k: the study consumes ONE initialization: the committed Top-1
search._execution: D4's bit-identical execution options (search_record.json :: execution); the beam tree is the declared single-profile 34 expansions

export._: the LFS batch endpoint admitted 1.475 GB and refused 1.494 GB on 2026-10-26; one 1.19 GB Top-1 fits

_budget: the bound of mixed_feasibility_v2.json :: compute.search.2x.bound -- DEPTH in all 16 positions it can take plus the 8-minute search fixed cost -- IS the contingency, so none is added on top; the expected session is 198.5 min. The hard terminate is the $15 cap

network_volume._: created for MC1 only (runs/mixvol_*), deleted after the Top-1 and the evidence are durable and read back
